pool.text: English settlers established the present-day location of the city under Charles Wolverstone.
The British constructed a new bridge over the Careenage.
Barbados became the seat of the Anglican Diocese of Barbados and the Leeward Islands.
Royal letters patent decreed that the Town of Bridgetown should be called the City of Bridgetown.
The College of Arms in London granted arms to the City of Bridgetown.
Local government councils were dissolved and replaced by an interim commissioner for local government.
Bridgetown established a twinning agreement with Hackney in the United Kingdom.
The City of Bridgetown played host to the United Nations Global Conference.
A dredging project was completed allowing the city to host cruise ships.
Bridgetown was twinned with Bridgetown, Nova Scotia, Canada.
Bridgetown established a twinning relationship with Wilmington, North Carolina.
The historic Kensington Oval hosted the Cricket World Cup final.
Historic Bridgetown and its Garrison was listed as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.
Bridgetown formed a twin city connection with Hunan province in China.
Bridgetown established an official twinning arrangement with New York City.
